## What to Watch
- CPU or Memory > 85% sustained
- Disk usage > 85% (/, External-SSD, Time Machine)
- Ping loss > 2% or latency spikes
- Wi‑Fi RSSI below -70 dBm or SNR below 20 dB

options.content:
## Read Me
This Grafana workspace monitors your macOS system with Prometheus + node_exporter.

Dashboards:
- Mac System: Core Health — CPU, memory, disk usage (including External-SSD + Time Machine), disk I/O
- Mac Network: Connectivity & Wi‑Fi — throughput, errors/drops, ping health, Wi‑Fi signal/rates
- Mac Info: Identity & Status — system identity, key specs, running launchd services
- All Metrics: Live Explorer — all active Prometheus metrics (live only)

Retention:
- Prometheus data retention: 14 days
- Storage cap: 20 GB

Exporters and launchd:
- node_exporter (Homebrew service)
- Custom exporters (launchd): net_connectivity, system_info, launchd_metrics
- Root daemon: wdutil_metrics for Wi‑Fi metrics

- Throughput RX/TX (all or selected interfaces)
- Packets RX/TX
- Errors RX/TX
- Drops RX/TX
- Multicast
- Total bytes
- Top interfaces by throughput
- Average packet size
- Connectivity (ping latency/loss)
- Interface link state (en0/en1)
- Wi‑Fi signal (RSSI/Noise/SNR), rates, CCA, MCS, NSS
